newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOKYO RUBBER FUTURES END HIGHER ON SHORT-COVERING.
newsitem.headline: TOKYO RUBBER FUTURES END HIGHER ON SHORT-COVERING.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended slightly higher on moderate short-covering on Thursday after lacklustre activity, traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.0 yen to 2.2 yen per kg higher. Benchmark January was up 2.2 yen at 121.3 yen.

"Sporadic short-covering, in a technical correction of recent price falls, lifted prices," one analyst at a commodity brokerage said. "The market continued to suffer from a dearth of fresh factors," he said.
Traders said rubber prices were likely to drift in narrow ranges for some time, looking for direction.
